row.team_price_text: Standard: as low as $13/mo/user (50 to 300 users)
row.evidence: Strategy's Workstation help says 'Strategy One (September 2025) adds support for System for Cross-Domain Identity Management (SCIM) 2.0 protocol', but the pricing page (Standard from $13/mo/user, Enterprise and Government on quote) does not say which plan includes SCIM.
row.notes: MicroStrategy now trades as Strategy (Strategy One / Strategy Mosaic). SCIM 2.0 is a documented Library server feature since Strategy One September 2025, enabled per environment in Workstation with a generated bearer token; Okta (custom SAML/SWA app) and Entra (non-gallery app) setup guides plus PingFederate. The pricing page lists Standard ($13/mo/user, 50-300 users), Enterprise and Government (quote) but names neither SSO nor SCIM per plan, so status is unknown rather than free: the docs set no edition gate, but the plan is not stated. Okta deletes are not propagated (manual delete in Library). A full REST API (users, user groups, security roles) is documented with X-MSTR-AuthToken session auth; plan gate not stated.

deprovision.data_retained: Okta deactivates (active=false maps to 'Enabled user'); Okta deletes do not delete the Library user. A SCIM DELETE (e.g. Entra) keeps the user's profile content, reassigning file ownership to Administrator; subscriptions where the user was the only recipient are deleted.

pagination.notes: count defaults to 1000; totalResults is not accurate; no sorting.

custom.how: Strategy extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:strategy:2.0:User (distinguishedName); any core/enterprise/strategy attribute can be mapped to user system prompts

attributes.notes: The enterprise extension schema is read only for system-prompt mapping; no fixed enterprise attributes are mapped.

roles.how: No SCIM role attribute is documented; privileges come from group membership and security roles (REST API).

limitations.text: Okta deletes are not propagated; users must be deleted manually in Library. Okta SCIM cannot be added to an OIDC app (use SAML or SWA app).
Only one email per user; sub-attributes of complex types (e.g. name.familyName) cannot be custom-mapped.
Filtering only on userName eq / displayName eq; no sorting; totalResults is inaccurate.
SCIM sync cannot remove groups manually added by an admin.
